name: Pottery
notes: Jars, urns and pots (mw-e03.11). Pottery breaks by fragility rather than wear: the placement sets a low fragile threshold (about 15 J, a dropped jar or any blow), and no resistance covers the rest. Four small 0.12 m shards; a shattering pot is about 70 dB at 1 m, loud enough to draw a guard.
